# apim_documentation_api (Resource)

DocumentationAPI Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apim_apiv4" "pets-api" {
  hrid = "pets-api"
  // other properties ommited for simplicity
}

resource "apim_documentation_api" "api-docs" {
  api_hrid = apim_apiv4.pets-api.hrid
  hrid     = "api-docs"
  name     = "API Documentation"
  type     = "GRAVITEE_MARKDOWN"
  content  = <<-EOT
  # Pets API

  This documentation page is attached directly to the API via `apim_documentation_api`.
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_hrid` (String) Human-readable ID of api
- `content` (String) The content of the documentation page
- `hrid` (String) A unique human readable id identifying this resource. Requires replacement if changed.
- `name` (String) Display name of the documentation page
- `type` (String) The type of documentation page. must be one of ["GRAVITEE_MARKDOWN", "OPENAPI", "ASYNCAPI"]

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) environment ID
- `location` (String) The path in the navigation hierarchy where this page should appear.
- `order` (Number) Display order relative to siblings at the same location
- `organization_id` (String) organization ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apim_documentation_api.api-docs
  id = jsonencode({
    api_hrid        = "pets-api"
    environment_id  = "DEFAULT"
    hrid            = "api-docs"
    organization_id = "DEFAULT"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apim_documentation_api.api-docs '{"api_hrid": "pets-api", "environment_id": "DEFAULT", "hrid": "api-docs", "organization_id": "DEFAULT"}'
```
